en.page_models_description: Manage provider connections and models. Switch this session or choose a default for the next one.
en.page_resources_description: Find your extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes. Manage their configured paths in one place.
en.page_host_description: Configure grok-pi features and terminal behavior. Review your changes before saving.
en.page_settings_description: Tune models, context, connections and tools with guided fields or the full JSON editor.
en.pick_provider: Select a provider to inspect its models and connection settings.
en.no_models: This provider has no matching models.
en.res_extensions_hint: Only entries sourced from settings.json can be removed here. CLI entries are read-only.
en.host_readonly_hint: Read-only: nested TOML tables are intentionally not edited by this page.
en.host_error_banner: config.toml could not be read — editing is disabled: {error}
en.raw_json_hint: Advanced editor · shares the same draft as the form
en.provider_form_hint: Preserves provider fields this form does not manage.
en.model_form_hint: Model-specific values override provider defaults when present.
en.f_apikey: API key or environment variable name
en.banner_models: models.json failed to parse — saving is disabled until the file is fixed: {error}
en.banner_settings: settings.json failed to parse — saving is disabled until the file is fixed: {error}
en.confirm_stop: Stop this temporary web configuration server?
en.fatal_401: Unauthorized. Re-open the URL printed by grok-pi.
en.stopped: Server stopped. Run /pi-config web or /pi-models web in grok-pi to start it again.
en.setting_hide_thinking_desc: Hide reasoning blocks in the normal transcript.
en.setting_skill_commands_desc: Expose installed skills as slash commands.
en.setting_quiet_startup_desc: Reduce startup banners and nonessential notices.
en.setting_collapse_changelog_desc: Keep changelog output compact on startup.
en.err_settings_object: settings.json must contain a JSON object.
en.search_hint: Models, resources and settings · Ctrl / ⌘ K
en.search_empty: No matches. Try a model name, setting key or resource path.
en.search_more: Showing the first 50 matches. Refine your search for more.
en.draft_hint: Changes stay in this page until you save.
en.conflict: Configuration changed outside this page. Discard your draft and refresh before retrying.
en.resolve_draft: Save or discard the Settings draft before this operation.
en.busy: Another operation is still running. Please wait.
en.err_model_exists: Model {id} already exists. Choose a different id.
en.err_nonnegative: {key} must be a finite non-negative number.
en.err_url: Base URL must be an http:// or https:// URL.
en.resource_manage_hint: Manage paths in global settings.json. Discovered and command-line resources remain read-only; removing a path does not delete files.
en.confirm_remove_resource: Remove ‘{path}’ from settings.json? No file will be deleted.
en.settings_scope_hint: Edits apply to the global Pi settings file. Project and command-line overrides can take precedence. Terminal-only preferences may not affect Grok Pager.
en.settings_group_defaults_desc: Choose startup defaults and how queued messages are delivered.
en.settings_group_context_desc: Control when Pi compacts context and what it keeps.
en.settings_group_network_desc: Configure Pi connections. A timeout of 0 disables that timeout.
en.settings_group_tools_desc: Configure commands and image handling used by Pi.
en.host_saved: TUI settings saved. Items marked restart require a new grok-pi session.
en.shortcut_hint: Ctrl / ⌘ S to save · Esc to close
en.delete_active: This is the current or default provider/model. Select a replacement before deleting it.
en.api_key_hint: Stored in your local models.json. Prefer an environment variable name such as OPENAI_API_KEY.
en.sync_readonly: Read-only until configuration errors are fixed
en.settings_desc_defaultProvider: Provider Pi selects for new sessions when no command-line override is given.
en.settings_desc_defaultModel: Model Pi selects for new sessions; use an ID from your model catalog.
en.settings_desc_defaultThinkingLevel: Requested reasoning effort. Supported levels depend on the selected model.
en.settings_desc_steeringMode: Deliver queued mid-turn messages one at a time or together.
en.settings_desc_followUpMode: Deliver queued follow-up messages one at a time or together after the current turn.
en.settings_desc_compaction_enabled: Let Pi summarize older context automatically when the context window fills.
en.settings_desc_compaction_reserveTokens: Context capacity reserved before automatic compaction starts.
en.settings_desc_compaction_keepRecentToken: Recent conversation tokens Pi preserves during compaction.
en.settings_desc_branchSummary_skipPrompt: Navigate session-tree branches without asking whether to summarize the branch.
en.settings_desc_transport: Choose the provider connection transport; Automatic lets Pi select it.
en.settings_desc_retry_enabled: Let Pi retry transient provider failures.
en.settings_desc_retry_maxRetries: Maximum number of retries for a failed provider request.
en.settings_desc_retry_baseDelayMs: Initial delay before retrying; later retries can wait longer.
en.settings_desc_httpProxy: HTTP proxy address Pi uses for provider requests.
en.settings_desc_httpIdleTimeoutMs: Maximum idle time for an HTTP response; 0 disables the timeout.
en.settings_desc_websocketConnectTimeoutMs: Maximum time to establish a WebSocket connection; 0 disables the timeout.
en.settings_desc_externalEditor: Command Pi uses to open an external editor.
en.settings_desc_shellPath: Shell executable Pi uses for shell commands.
en.settings_desc_images_autoResize: Resize large images before sending them to the model.
en.settings_desc_images_blockImages: Prevent image attachments from being sent to the model.

zh.page_models_description: 管理服务商连接与模型，切换本次会话模型，或为新会话设置默认值。
zh.page_resources_description: 查找扩展、技能、提示词模板和主题，统一管理配置路径。
zh.page_host_description: 配置 grok-pi 功能与终端行为，检查修改后统一保存。
zh.page_settings_description: 使用分类表单或完整 JSON 编辑器，调整模型、上下文、连接与工具。
zh.search_providers: 搜索 服务商 或模型
zh.providers_visible: 显示 {visible} / {total} 个 服务商
zh.no_provider_match: 没有匹配的 服务商。
zh.pick_provider: 选择一个 服务商 查看模型与连接配置。
zh.no_models: 这个 服务商 没有匹配的模型。
zh.res_extensions_hint: 只有来自 settings.json 的条目可以在这里移除；CLI 注入条目只读。
zh.res_readonly_hint: 扫描到的资源仅用于浏览，不在此处修改。
zh.host_readonly_hint: 只读：嵌套 TOML 表有意不在此页面修改。
zh.host_error_banner: config.toml 读取失败——已禁用编辑：{error}
zh.raw_json_hint: 高级编辑器 · 与表单共享同一份草稿
zh.provider_form_hint: 不会覆盖本表单未管理的 服务商 字段。
zh.add_model_title: 向 {服务商} 添加模型
zh.model_form_hint: 模型字段存在时会覆盖 服务商 默认值。
zh.f_apikey: API Key 或环境变量名
zh.banner_models: models.json 解析失败——修复文件前已禁用保存：{error}
zh.banner_settings: settings.json 解析失败——修复文件前已禁用保存：{error}
zh.toast_default_set: 默认模型已设为 {服务商}/{model}。
zh.toast_settings_saved: settings.json 已保存，Pi 已重载。
zh.toast_host_saved_restart: {key} 已保存——重启 grok-pi 后生效。
zh.confirm_delete_provider: 确定从 models.json 删除 服务商“{id}”吗？
zh.confirm_stop: 确定停止这个临时网页配置服务吗？
zh.err_provider_id: 服务商 id 不能为空。
zh.err_model_id: 模型 id 不能为空。
zh.fatal_title: Pi 网页配置台不可用
zh.fatal_401: 未授权。请重新打开 grok-pi 输出的配置页地址。
zh.stopped: 服务已停止。在 grok-pi 中重新运行 /pi-config web 或 /pi-models web 即可再次启动。
zh.setting_hide_thinking_desc: 在常规对话中隐藏思考块。
zh.setting_skill_commands_desc: 把已安装 Skills 暴露为斜杠命令。
zh.setting_quiet_startup_desc: 减少启动横幅和非必要提示。
zh.setting_install_telemetry_desc: 允许 Pi 的安装相关遥测。
zh.setting_analytics_desc: 允许 Pi 产品分析统计。
zh.err_settings_object: settings.json 必须是 JSON 对象。
zh.search_hint: 模型、资源与设置 · Ctrl / ⌘ K
zh.search_empty: 没有匹配项，试试模型名、配置键或资源路径。
zh.search_more: 显示前 50 条结果，请缩小搜索范围。
zh.draft_hint: 修改会保留在本页，点击保存后才写入配置。
zh.conflict: 配置已被其他程序修改。请放弃草稿并刷新后重试。
zh.resolve_draft: 请先保存或放弃「Pi 设置」中的草稿，再执行此操作。
zh.busy: 上一项操作尚未完成，请稍候。
zh.headers_error: 请求头的值必须是字符串。
zh.err_model_exists: 模型 {id} 已存在，请使用其他标识。
zh.err_url: 接口地址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
zh.resource_manage_hint: 管理全局 settings.json 中的路径。自动发现和命令行资源只读；移除路径不会删除文件。
zh.confirm_remove_resource: 从 settings.json 移除「{path}」？不会删除磁盘文件。
zh.settings_scope_hint: 编辑全局 Pi 设置。项目和命令行配置可能覆盖这些值；Pi 终端专用偏好不一定影响 Grok Pager。
zh.settings_group_defaults_desc: 设置启动默认值，以及队列消息的发送方式。
zh.settings_group_context_desc: 控制 Pi 的上下文自动压缩与保留范围。
zh.settings_group_network_desc: 管理 Pi 的连接行为。超时值为 0 时禁用该超时。
zh.settings_group_tools_desc: 设置 Pi 使用的命令与图片处理方式。
zh.host_saved: 界面设置已保存。标注「需要重启」的项目需开启新的 grok-pi 会话。
zh.shortcut_hint: Ctrl / ⌘ S 保存 · Esc 关闭
zh.delete_active: 这是当前或默认服务商/模型，请先选择替代项再删除。
zh.api_key_hint: 保存在本地 models.json 中，建议填写环境变量名，如 OPENAI_API_KEY。
zh.settings_desc_defaultProvider: 未通过命令行指定时，Pi 为新会话选择的服务商。
zh.settings_desc_defaultModel: Pi 为新会话选择的模型，填写模型目录中的 ID。
zh.settings_desc_defaultThinkingLevel: 请求的推理强度；可用等级由所选模型决定。
zh.settings_desc_steeringMode: 在执行过程中逐条发送插入消息，或一次发送全部排队消息。
zh.settings_desc_followUpMode: 当前轮次结束后，逐条发送后续消息，或一次发送全部排队消息。
zh.settings_desc_compaction_enabled: 上下文接近容量上限时，由 Pi 自动概括较早内容。
zh.settings_desc_compaction_reserveTokens: 自动压缩开始前，预留的上下文 Token 数。
zh.settings_desc_compaction_keepRecentToken: 压缩时 Pi 保留的最近对话 Token 数。
zh.settings_desc_branchSummary_skipPrompt: 跳转会话树分支时，不再询问是否生成分支摘要。
zh.settings_desc_transport: 选择服务商的连接协议；自动模式由 Pi 选择。
zh.settings_desc_retry_enabled: 服务商发生临时故障时，允许 Pi 重试。
zh.settings_desc_retry_maxRetries: 服务商请求失败后，最多重试的次数。
zh.settings_desc_retry_baseDelayMs: 首次重试前的等待时间；后续重试可能等待更久。
zh.settings_desc_httpProxy: Pi 请求服务商时使用的 HTTP 代理地址。
zh.settings_desc_httpIdleTimeoutMs: HTTP 响应允许的最长空闲时间；0 表示禁用超时。
zh.settings_desc_websocketConnectTimeoutMs: 建立 WebSocket 连接允许的最长时间；0 表示禁用超时。
zh.settings_desc_externalEditor: Pi 打开外部编辑器时使用的命令。
zh.settings_desc_shellPath: Pi 执行 Shell 命令时使用的可执行文件路径。
zh.settings_desc_images_autoResize: 发送给模型前，自动缩小过大的图片。
zh.settings_desc_images_blockImages: 阻止将图片附件发送给模型。
